title: Finite constant-module Tor tests for an open direct image
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, and let $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small étale sites and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $a\le b$ be integers and $e\ge0$ an integer. Let $L\in D^+(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Suppose $R^qj_*F=0$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] for every $A$-module sheaf $F$ and every $q>e$. Suppose also that, for every finite $A$-module $M$, the natural projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] for the derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]
$$ (Rj_*L)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}M_T\longrightarrow Rj_*(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}M_V) $$
is an isomorphism, where $M_S$ denotes the constant module sheaf on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Then, for every finite A-module M and every integer q with q<a or b+e<q, the cohomology sheaf H^q((Rj_*L) tensor_A^L M_T) vanishes. This is the finite-constant-test part of the all-module-sheaf Tor bound.

source.place: Step 3, passage from finite constant-module Tor tests for Rj_* L to all module sheaves by stalks and filtered unions.

proof.text: Put $Q=Rj_*L$. For a finite $A$-module $M$ set $E_M=L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}M_V$. The constant sheaf $M_V$ is one of the degree-zero sheaves allowed in the Tor-amplitude hypothesis. Thus $\mathcal H^r(E_M)=0$ for $r\notin[a,b]$. In particular $E_M$ is bounded below, even though finite $A$-modules need not have finite projective dimension.

proof.text: Represent E_M by a bounded-below injective complex I zero below a using the bounded-below injective representative theorem. Its underlying complex is K-injective. The source library computes the existing unbounded right derived functor on I by Q(j_*I). Additivity preserves zero terms, hence gives the lower cohomological bound a. This uses the source rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso directly and the existing Grothendieck-abelian instances; no comparison with a ringed-site module encoding is required.

The source homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso identifies the given degree-zero cohomological vanishing with vanishing of the classical right derived functors. Apply finiteCDDerivedUpperBound with N=e. To identify its functor with the existing unbounded rightDerivedFunctor, factor termwise j_* followed by localization through the homotopy quotient. Fully faithful precomposition gives the factorization its left Kan extension property. Composing with the existing derived-functor Kan extension gives a cochain-level right derived functor; uniqueness compares it with the functor supplied by finiteCDDerivedUpperBound. Transport its upper bound b+e. Finally singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso and constantSheafCompUpperStarIso identify the derived pullback of M_T[0] with M_V[0]. Apply the tensor functor and Rj_* to this comparison, compose with the assumed projection isomorphism, and transport both cohomological bounds to (Rj_*L) tensor^L M_T.

lean.statement:
theorem open_tor_bound_finite_constant_tests
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ p)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (l ^ n) • x = 0)
    {V T : Scheme.{u}}
    (aV : V ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aT : T ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aV] [QuasiCompact aV]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aT] [QuasiCompact aT]
    (j : V ⟶ T) (_hj : j ≫ aT = aV) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (a b e : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b) (_he : 0 ≤ e)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (_hL : DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn A V a b
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj L))
    (_hvanish : ∀ (q : ℤ)
      (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)),
      e < q → IsZero
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) q).obj
          ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).obj
            ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).obj F))))
    (_hproj : ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A), Finite M → IsIso
      (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).app
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj L)).app
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj M)))) :
    ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A), Finite M → ∀ (q : ℤ),
      q < a ∨ b + e < q → IsZero
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) q).obj
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj
            ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj L))).obj
            ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).obj
              ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj M))))
